title: Creator Assertion Status
description: Experimental (media_buy.social_profiles). Signed status of one creator sales-authorization credential, served at the credential's optional status_url. It is a JWS compact serialization with typ adcp-creator-assertion-status+jws. It is signed by a key from the credential's JWKS with the same attestation-signing purpose. The status values mirror the rights-grant grant_status (active, paused, revoked) and add unknown. this_update and next_update work as they do in OCSP. An unsigned, wrongly signed, stale or unreachable status yields unverifiable, never revoked.

credential_id.description: The credential_id this status answers for. It MUST equal the credential's, or the status is unverifiable.

status.description: active: the issuer still makes the claim. paused: the issuer has suspended the claim and may resume it, but only by issuing a new credential with a new credential_id. revoked: the issuer has withdrawn the claim. unknown: the issuer does not recognize the credential_id. Only active can evaluate to verified. paused, revoked and unknown evaluate to revoked. A paused or revoked credential never becomes active again.

this_update.description: When the issuer determined this status. A status whose this_update is more than 60 seconds after the evaluation time is not current.

next_update.description: When the issuer will next determine the status. A status is current only while next_update is in the future. A status that is not current yields unverifiable, never revoked.

reason.description: Human-readable reason for a paused or revoked status, such as the creator disconnecting the operator. Informational only.
